title: Drop non-English forced ASS subtitles
summary: Make ASS language filtering strict so forced/SDH metadata does not retain non-English ASS tracks.
reason: Operator policy is that only English ASS should be eligible for conversion/attachment; non-English ASS should be dropped even when marked forced.
behavior_before: ASS tracks outside the configured ASS language policy could still be retained by forced or SDH metadata, then handled by later routing.
behavior_after: ASS tracks must match the configured ASS language policy to be retained. Non-English ASS is dropped before routing even when forced or SDH, and defensive routing drops any non-policy ASS entry that reaches it.
tests_added: Updated regression coverage so non-English forced ASS is dropped before routing and still drops defensively if routed.
rollback_plan: Revert the ASS-specific language-policy and routing changes in routing_decisions.ps1 plus the updated unit assertions, then rerun the subtitle builder decision checks.
notes:
Follow-up operator policy: non-English forced ASS should be dropped, not preserved or converted.
Refreshed affected generated summaries after ASS forced-language policy change.
Strict worktree coverage passed after this follow-up packet.
